t: What he said as the food was taken away
a: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ غَيْرَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبُّنَا
p: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh, ghayra muwaddaʿin wa lā mustaghnan ʿanhu rabbanā
m: Praise be to Allah, praise that is abundant, good and blessed, not a farewell and not something we can do without, our Lord.
